title: Progress Event
description: One line of progress as data: the qualified catalog key `<namespace>.<key>`, the values of its placeholders and the severity level. Every level is written to the diagnostic stream: the result stream carries only the command result. No text is stored; the CLI boundary renders the event in the language it resolved.

FaultDetail.description: A stage of the ready supervisor sets `environment` to `enabled`: every internal fault at the CLI boundary then also writes one line `prefix` + reference + the JSON of its cause chain (name, message and the first `maximumStackLines` stack frames of each of at most `maximumErrors` faults, cut at `maximumCharacters`) before the internal-error line, so the failed-stage log in the fleet store names the throwing frame. A terminal run without the variable never prints a stack.

TypedRefusals.description: The closed list of typed refusal classes a CLI boundary renders as themselves, without the internal-error prefix, besides the refusals of the process catalog (`RepoError`), failed child commands, disk-full faults, expired resource loans and cancellations. `text` `texts`: the fault carries both languages in `texts`; `text` `message`: the message of the fault is the final text. A fault matches by its `name` or by its `code`; `exit` is the exit status.
